nodes.name: Normalize Job Payload
nodes.notes: Custom JavaScript: Normalize incoming job records to a stable schema Watch out: Must return an array of items shaped like [{ json: {...} }].

nodes.name: Route by Work Type
nodes.notes: Routes each item to one of 4 lanes: standard, priority, batch + fallback. Watch out: Unmatched items go to the fallback output; without one they are silently dropped.

nodes.name: Process 'standard' → Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Upserts a row into 'Job Tracker', matched on jobId — re-running with the same key updates the row instead of duplicating it. Retries 3x with 2s backoff before giving up. Google Cloud Console → enable Sheets API → OAuth2 client, or a Service Account.

nodes.name: Fast-Track 'priority' + Alert
nodes.notes: Sends an email via Gmail — subject is the first line of the message body, recipient comes from the item's email field. Retries 3x with 2s backoff before giving up. On failure the item leaves via the error output instead of stopping the run. Credential: Google OAuth2. Google Cloud Console → enable Gmail API → OAuth consent screen → OAuth client ID (Web).

nodes.notes: Sends an email via Gmail — subject is the first line of the message body, recipient comes from the item's email field. Retries 3x with 2s backoff before giving up. On failure the item leaves via the error output instead of stopping the run. Credential: Google OAuth2. Google Cloud Console → enable Gmail API → OAuth consent screen → OAuth client ID (Web).

nodes.name: Hold Unknown Types (DLQ)
nodes.notes: Appends a new row to 'Job Tracker' — a human-readable audit trail that doesn't require opening n8n to inspect. Retries 3x with 2s backoff before giving up. On failure the item leaves via the error output instead of stopping the run. Credential: Google OAuth2 / service account. Google Cloud Console → enable Sheets API → OAuth2 client, or a Service Account.

nodes.name: Merge Routed Work
nodes.notes: Rejoins 4 branches into one stream (mode: append) so downstream logic runs once. Watch out: Waits for every configured input. If one branch never produces items, add 'Always Output Data' upstream so this doesn't stall.

nodes.name: Guard Non-Empty type
nodes.notes: Drops items that fail the condition; only qualifying items continue (no false branch).

nodes.name: Tag Pipeline Metadata
nodes.notes: Shapes the item: writes pipeline, version. Keeps the schema explicit between stages.

nodes.name: Save Execution Metadata
nodes.notes: Saves key fields onto the execution record — searchable later in n8n's execution list.

nodes.name: Sort Jobs Newest First
nodes.notes: Orders items (newest first) so limits and digests pick the most relevant records.

nodes.name: Align Field Names
nodes.notes: Normalizes field names so every source feeds the same downstream schema.

nodes.name: Summarize Run Stats
nodes.notes: Shapes the item: writes runAt, itemCount, status. Keeps the schema explicit between stages.

# Automate a multi-step process with HTTP / REST API and Google Sheets automatically

**Pattern:** Workflow Automation · **Level:** Advanced · **Trigger:** Scheduled

## What it does
Automate a multi-step process with HTTP / REST API and Google Sheets automatically. It runs automatically on a schedule.

## Why it exists
Manual triggers is slow and error-prone; this workflow makes the process repeatable, monitored and hands-off, with failures surfaced instead of silently lost.

## Main flow
Weekly Schedule → Normalize Job Payload → Route by Work Type → Process 'standard' → Google Sheets → Merge Routed Work → Guard Non-Empty type → Tag Pipeline Metadata → …

## Use it for
- Teams that want to workflow automation without manual effort
- Anyone automating triggers in productivity
- Replacing a fragile manual process with a reliable workflow

## You get
- Removes copy-paste errors
- Has retries and error handling built in
- Runs 24/7 in the background

## Before first run
Connect credentials: Google OAuth2; Google OAuth2 / service account.
Follow the color key: 🟦 entry · 🟪 AI · 🟫 actions · ⬜ utilities · 🟩 outputs · 🟥 error rail.
Each node has its own doc card underneath — read those before editing.

## Try it now
Sample data is pinned on the trigger — hit **Execute Workflow** to watch it flow through every node before connecting any real credentials. Unpin the trigger (right-click → Unpin) when you're ready to go live.

## Design decisions

Unrecognized work types are parked in a dead-letter lane instead of erroring the whole run or silently dropping the item — new event kinds will show up eventually, and this is where you'd notice one without losing it. One kind is deliberately routed through a sub-workflow to show how heavier per-type logic can be extracted without touching this router at all.

## Practice exercises

You've got the basics covered — push further:

1. Send a work-type value that matches no switch rule and confirm it lands in the dead-letter branch.
2. Add a new work type and its own handling branch.
3. Replace the direct-write branch with a sub-workflow call, matching the pattern already used for the first kind.

## Credentials setup

Credentials are never included in a template file, so every node below needs its own connection before the first real run. In n8n: open the node, click the Credential dropdown, choose **Create new**.

**Google OAuth2 / service account**
Google Cloud Console → enable Sheets API → OAuth2 client, or a Service Account.
_Gotcha:_ Using a Service Account? Share the spreadsheet with its email address or it 404s.

**Google OAuth2**
Google Cloud Console → enable Gmail API → OAuth consent screen → OAuth client ID (Web).
_Gotcha:_ Add n8n's OAuth redirect URL exactly as shown in the credential, or the consent loop fails.

Set each credential up once and it is reusable across every workflow in your instance.

## Troubleshooting

**Workflow does nothing when the trigger should fire**
Cause: It is still a draft, or the trigger is inactive.
Fix: Publish/activate the workflow. Manual test runs use a different URL than production.

**A node shows a red error triangle on import**
Cause: No credential is attached yet.
Fix: Expected on a fresh import — open the node and attach a credential (see the Credentials setup note).

**Execution stalls at the Merge node**
Cause: One input branch produced no items, so Merge is still waiting.
Fix: Enable 'Always Output Data' on the node feeding the empty branch.

Still stuck? n8n's **Executions** tab shows the exact node that failed and the data going into it — start there rather than guessing.

## 🛟 Error handling & retries

External calls retry **3× with 2s backoff**. Anything still failing exits through its node's error output into the red error rail → context is captured and the on-call channel is alerted. Set an n8n **Error Workflow** in settings as the final safety net.

## 🛠 Customize me

Quick wins: point the data nodes at your own accounts (see 🔑 lines on each card), adjust the trigger cadence, and tune thresholds/labels to your triggers process. Every node card explains its role — safe to extend at any marked branch.
